scene:
Three areas side by side, read left to right. Do not write any title or heading above any area.

On the left, narrow: one large inspection document sheet with a teal category tab and a big ochre check mark over it, labelled DOCUMENT ACCEPTED. The sheet itself has only blank ruled lines, no writing.

In the centre, wide: a waterfall bridge chart of five bars on one baseline, read left to right. First, a short navy bar standing on the baseline, labelled APRIL €1,400. Second, a floating teal bar stepping up from the top of the first, labelled USAGE +€2,644, with a small crowd-of-documents icon. Third, a taller floating ochre bar stepping up further, labelled CONSTRUCTION +€3,236, with a small wrench-and-gear icon. Fourth, a floating bar stepping DOWN from the top of the third, drawn with a downward arrow and a small scissors icon, labelled PRICE CUT −€1,456. Fifth, a navy bar standing on the baseline, taller than the first but lower than the peak, labelled AUGUST €5,824. Thin dashed connector lines join the top of each bar to the next.

On the right, three stacked elements.
Top: two cards side by side. A larger teal card with an upward arrow, labelled 90% BEFORE STAFF COSTS. A smaller ochre card with a small person-with-laptop icon and a downward arrow, labelled €800 SHORT AFTER STAFF.
Middle: a wide shaded horizontal band labelled DEMAND RANGE, and below the band a solid navy floor line with a small anchor icon, labelled FLOOR €2,400/MONTH, clearly sitting below the band.
Bottom: three small road signs in a row: a price tag icon on the sign labelled REPRICE, a person with a magnifying glass on the sign labelled PLANNER REVIEW, a pause symbol on the sign labelled SUSPEND.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: DOCUMENT ACCEPTED, APRIL €1,400, USAGE +€2,644, CONSTRUCTION +€3,236, PRICE CUT −€1,456, AUGUST €5,824, 90% BEFORE STAFF COSTS, €800 SHORT AFTER STAFF, DEMAND RANGE, FLOOR €2,400/MONTH, REPRICE, PLANNER REVIEW, SUSPEND. No headings or titles of any kind, no axis numbers, no writing on the document or the price tag. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A sorted document with a check mark marks the unit, a document accepted; a bridge chart runs from €1,400 in April through usage +€2,644, construction +€3,236 and a price cut −€1,456 to €5,824 in August; a return card reads 90% before staff costs above a smaller card reading €800 short after staff; a commitment floor of €2,400 a month sits below a demand band; a price tag and two signs read reprice, planner review and suspend.
caption: Count the accepted document, split the bill into usage, construction and price, state the return with its period and condition, commit below the demand range, and set the stop rules first.
